ctaLabel: I want my own radio show
waText: Hi Hedva, I'd like to hear about having my own show on the IVR Prod International Advisors Channel.
intlTitle: Broadcast from anywhere in the world
intlLead: The new international channel for consultants, coaches and therapists. London, Berlin, Toronto or Tel Aviv: wherever there is internet, you are on air.
strip0: You can broadcast from anywhere in the world too.
benefitsTitle: Everything you need for your voice to be heard
benefitsLead: We take care of the technology, the broadcast and the stage. You bring the knowledge.

benefits.title: Your own radio show
benefits.text: A regular show that carries your name and is identified with you and your field.

benefits.title: Live audio and video broadcasts
benefits.text: Listeners hear you, and see you, in real time.

benefits.title: Stream to social media
benefits.text: Your show can go out on your social channels at the same time, reaching your existing audience and new listeners.

benefits.title: Broadcast from anywhere in the world
benefits.text: No studio and no travel. A computer, headphones and a microphone, and you are on air.

benefits.title: Authority and a personal brand
benefits.text: A radio show positions you as the leading voice in your field.

benefits.title: Exposure, trust and opportunities
benefits.text: Listeners who know your voice become clients who trust you.

benefits.title: Interviews and guest experts
benefits.text: Host colleagues, clients and professionals, and grow your professional network.

strip1: Want a show of your own? Talk to us now.
founderTitle: Everyone with knowledge has a voice worth hearing
founderText:
I believe that everyone with knowledge and experience has a voice that deserves to be heard.
Since founding the station in 2019, I have learned the power of the microphone to connect people and create opportunities.
I founded the International Advisors Channel to give professionals a stage to make their voice heard, share their knowledge and become an authority in their field.
founderQuote: You bring the knowledge and the voice. We give them a stage.
strip2: Ready to make your voice heard?
closingLead: Send us a WhatsApp message and we will get back to you for a short call about your show.
